A separately declared structural follow-up characterizes all 51 score graphs

\paragraph{Post-failure structural characterization.}
A separately versioned diagnostic used the original pre-guard whole-source
prefix of 1,001 development-training records and its stored E5 rows.
All 51 original cutoffs were retained. The first 25, $.50$ through $.74$,
produced complete graphs; $.995$ produced an empty graph. Deleting an
originally excluded record could admit another record at 13 cuts,
$.84$ through $.96$. The exact expected admissions under uniform deletion
of 128 records ranged from zero to 12.51 across the full grid. These are
conditional structural properties of this panel, without established
semantic usefulness or task benefit. The execution matched every graph
under two tile sizes, and a separate aggregate audit verified all 204
exact expectations for budgets $1,8,32,128$. No task labels, held-out
feature rows, model judgments or learner heads were used. No cutoff was
selected, and the failed calibration gates remain unchanged.
